text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 08 · 赛璐璐动画 · 珊瑚环城的玻璃车站 · 海松绿 / 珊瑚粉 / 奶黄.
Environment: Hand-drawn 2D animation background of an underwater glass transit station, elegant transparent arch tunnel curving through a city built from coral-like mineral towers, empty benches, seagrass, muted seafoam green with coral-pink and buttery yellow, delicate painted caustics, strong line clarity, water contains no fish or creatures.
Visual medium: cel animation; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 08 · 赛璐璐动画 · 珊瑚环城的玻璃车站 · 海松绿 / 珊瑚粉 / 奶黄. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions. IMPORTANT: Reference 2 ORIGINAL image determines artistic medium and color grading; keep watercolor / impasto painting / cel animation / clay miniature respectively. Reference 1 only determines spatial layout, NOT render style. Do not homogenize all scenes into photorealism.
